lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Good morning! It is me, Mr. Page. Welcome <color=red>back</color>!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Today is <color=red>dinosaur</color> day! Everyone loves dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Everyone took a dinosaur book home. Now my shelf is <color=red>empty</color>!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Oh dear! My library looks like a big, dark <color=red>cave</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus need <color=red>help</color> today. Go and see them.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Help all three, and my dinosaur books will <color=red>stomp</color> back home!

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Please help Barnaby, Tilly and Gus. Then come back and <color=red>tell</color> me!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Wow! The dinosaur books are all <color=red>back</color>!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped Barnaby, Tilly and Gus. You are <color=red>amazing</color>!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: I am so happy, I could <color=red>roar</color>! Thank you!

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: My shelf is full of dinosaurs again! Come and <color=red>read</color> about them any time.
